assertionSteps.title: 1. Given USER-A has the tab labelled "Home" in the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page focused and Cashflow workspace loaded
2. When USER-A presses "ArrowRight" on the tab labelled "Home" in the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And USER-A presses "Enter" on the tab labelled "Cashflow" in the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
4. Then The tab labelled "Cashflow" in the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page has selected state equal to true
5. And The tabpanel with identifier "workspaces-tabpanel-1" on the Home page is visible
